brief.goals: SIMULATED goals: improve source-specific purchase-credit CPA and ROAS for paid ads; improve unique clicks per delivered email and attributed value per delivery. brief.brand: SIMULATED training brief for a furniture retail scenario. Use only sofas, sectionals and living-room furniture as assumed catalog facts. Warm, straightforward tone. No prices, discounts, shipping, guarantees, manufacturing claims or actual client approval. Klaviyo, Mailchimp and HubSpot cohorts model email journeys/segments only; SMS is excluded.
